Package net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api

package net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api
Defines custom text styles, parses their formatting tokens, and computes animation samples.

Start with ChromaticDefinitions to register a named color or effect. A registration receipt belongs to one exact declaration: closing an older receipt cannot remove a newer replacement. Use one edit callback when several changes must become visible together.

ChromaticText turns text into visible glyphs and their styles. It retains raw token positions so measuring, trimming and wrapping can use the same decisions as rendering. These shared APIs do not create an OpenGL context.

Read the getting-started guide and formatting rules for concrete examples.
